definitions.explanation: A story or work that is invented or imaginary, not based on real events. Includes novels, films, and other creative works.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}はフィクションです。
フィクションと{実話|じつわ}の{区別|くべつ}がつかない。
examples.english: I can't tell the difference between fiction and a true story.

examples.japanese: この{小説|しょうせつ}はフィクションですが、{実在|じつざい}の{事件|じけん}をもとにしています。
examples.english: This novel is fiction, but it is based on a real incident.

notes:
フィクション refers to fictional content across all media — novels, films, TV, manga, etc. From English "fiction."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- フィクション{作品|さくひん} (fictional work)
- サイエンスフィクション / SF (science fiction)
- フィクションとノンフィクション (fiction and nonfiction)

CONTRAST:
- フィクション vs. ノンフィクション (fiction vs. nonfiction)
- フィクション vs. {実話|じつわ} (fiction vs. true story)
- フィクション vs. {事実|じじつ} (fiction vs. fact)

COMMON USAGE:
Often appears in disclaimers at the start of TV dramas and films: 「この{物語|ものがたり}はフィクションです。{実在|じつざい}の{人物|じんぶつ}・{団体|だんたい}とは{関係|かんけい}ありません」 (This story is fiction and has no relation to real people or organizations).
